summary: Backend-only iteration_6 verification of the three architectural fixes (PA_COMPAT_CAP=50, asyncio.wait_for(pa_fetch, 2.0), asyncio.as_completed(..., timeout=40.0) partial-results loop). USER-REPORTED BUG IS FIXED end-to-end on BOTH warm and cold cache paths: GET /api/oem-stock-search?q=Kit,chaine,distribution&model_id=39023 now returns HTTP 200 in ~40 s with count=43 (warm-compat) and count=14 (fully-cold) — versus iteration_5's count=0 / 45.16 s timeout. Small query regression also IMPROVED (count=2→12). 10/11 tests passed. The single failure (TestUserReportedOemCacheRow) is NOT a regression of iteration_6 fixes — it's a pre-existing flaky 3 s per-call FadPro timeout (server.py L1193) that under heavy 600-candidate × 3-variant concurrent load writes an empty items=[] cache row for some OEMs. Direct FadPro probes confirm the API DOES return 8 items for '1608745980' and 27 for '160874' when called without contention.

minor.issue: server.py L1193 `per_call_timeout = 3.0 if source in VARIANT_SOURCES` is too aggressive under heavy load (600 candidates × up to 3 FadPro variants each through Semaphore(60)). Direct probes show FadPro returns items=8 for '1608745980' and items=27 for '160874' in ~1-2 s without contention; under load the 3 s wait_for fires before completion and writes items=[] to cache. RECOMMENDATION: bump VARIANT_SOURCES per-call timeout from 3.0 → 5.0 s, or add a 'retry-on-empty-cache-row' on next request, or skip caching when ALL variants returned [] AND any of them timed out.
Copia/PartsPro cache rows = 61 each instead of strict <= 60 — minor race in semaphore admission allowed one extra call past LOCKED_SUPPLIER_CAP. Pre-existing from iteration_5, harmless.

action_items: OPTIONAL FOLLOW-UP (NOT BLOCKING): Bump VARIANT_SOURCES per-call FadPro timeout in cached_supplier_search (server.py L1193) from 3.0 → 5.0 s so that under heavy 600-candidate load the variant fallback actually completes for OEMs that need it (e.g. 1608745980). The architectural fixes in iter_6 are correct and the user-reported count=0 bug IS resolved — this is a flaky-third-party hardening improvement.

OPTIONAL: Avoid caching items=[] when ALL variants timed out (vs. all variants returned []). Currently we can't distinguish 'genuinely no items' from 'all variants timed out' — both write items=[] permanently. A small `had_timeout` flag would let us skip caching in the timeout case so the next request retries.
OPTIONAL: Tighten Copia/PartsPro admission so the count never exceeds 60 (currently 61) — minor.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L1249 PA_COMPAT_CAP=50 correctly placed at module-level near pa_sem.
server.py L1272-1278 get_compat_list's try/except hierarchy is sound: wait_for→TimeoutError returns None (keep items), generic Exception also returns None — robust.
server.py L1352 `get_compat_list(c['ref'], allow_fetch=idx < PA_COMPAT_CAP)` correctly gates the live scrape behind the cap; cached reads remain free for ALL candidates.

server.py L1378 the `asyncio.as_completed(pending_tasks, timeout=deadline)` pattern is the textbook fix for the partial-results problem — completed tasks are consumed as they finish, and on TimeoutError the in-flight tasks are explicitly cancelled (L1393-1395) so httpx sockets are not leaked.

server.py is now 1698 lines — same as iter_5. Still worth refactoring the OEM-search endpoint (~250 lines) into a separate module with SupplierCapManager / PiecesautosCompatService / VariantFallbackResolver classes. Not blocking.

L1193 `per_call_timeout = 5.0 if source not in VARIANT_SOURCES else 3.0` — the inverted threshold (variants get LESS time) is counter-intuitive: variant sources MAKE MORE CALLS (up to 3) so giving them less per call compounds the timeout pressure. Consider 5.0 s for all sources, or compute per-variant budget as `total_budget / num_variants`.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The user-reported bug from iteration_5 (q='Kit,chaine,distribution' → count=0 / 45 s global timeout) is RESOLVED. Three architectural fixes verified in server.py: (1) PA_COMPAT_CAP=50 at L1249; (2) asyncio.wait_for(pa_fetch(ref), timeout=2.0) at L1274; (3) asyncio.as_completed(pending_tasks, timeout=40.0) partial-results loop at L1378 with partial-timeout log at L1389. End-to-end measurements: warm-compat path 40.16 s / count=43, cold-both-caches path 40.18 s / count=14, small-query 7.28 s / count=2 (count=12 on rerun). The single failing test (OEM 1608745980 cache items=[]) is a pre-existing flaky-third-party issue caused by server.py L1193's 3 s per-call FadPro timeout under heavy load; direct FadPro probes confirm items DO exist (8 for 10-digit, 27 for 6-digit). Recommend main agent bump VARIANT_SOURCES per-call timeout from 3 → 5 s if surfacing the user's exact OEM is a hard requirement; otherwise iter_6 is complete.
rca_of_the_issue: The iter_5 root cause (piecesautos.tn compat-scraping ate the 45 s budget → all tasks cancelled → empty response) is fully addressed by iter_6's three diffs: (a) PA_COMPAT_CAP=50 limits live compat scrapes to first 50 candidates only; (b) asyncio.wait_for(pa_fetch, timeout=2.0) bounds each scrape to 2 s instead of the open-ended httpx default; (c) asyncio.as_completed(tasks, timeout=40.0) consumes completed lookups one-at-a-time and surfaces partial results when the deadline fires, rather than the old gather()+wait_for(45) which discarded ALL work on timeout. Measured impact: cold-cache run improved from 45.16 s/count=0 → 40.18 s/count=14. The single remaining failure (cache row for OEM 1608745980 has items=[]) is a DIFFERENT pre-existing issue: server.py L1193 sets per_call_timeout=3.0 for VARIANT_SOURCES, which under contention from 600 candidates × up to 3 FadPro variants × Semaphore(60) sometimes elapses before FadPro responds — writing items=[] to the cache. Direct uncontended probes prove FadPro DOES return items (8 for '1608745980', 27 for '160874'). Mitigation: bump VARIANT_SOURCES timeout to 5 s, OR skip caching items=[] when any variant timed out, OR add a one-time retry on empty cache rows.
